complicacoes.texto: Blue Beetle is best friends com Booster Gold, e their shared misadventures e sense of humor are notorious.

After he was injured saving Ted Kord’s life, the Moribundo wish of the first Blue Beetle (Dan Garrett) was that Kord carry on e continue his battle contra evil. Kord’s adventuring as the Blue Beetle is a never-ending effort to live up to the name e wishes of his predecessor.
